## PRB1.1. IFR movements {#prb1.1.-ifr-movements .Heading-2-ER}

- Switzerland recorded 1,200K actual IFR movements in 2025, +0.5% compared to 2024 (1,194K).

- Actual 2025 IFR movements were -1.7% below the plan (1,221K).

- Actual 2025 IFR movements were +2.0% above the actual 2019 level (1,177K).
